<!-- theorem-1: body_md -->
\label{cyckucmainp}
For each $0 <  p < \infty$, the function $\chi$ satisfies 
$$\overline{\operatorname{span}}\{C^n \chi: n \geqslant 0\} = H^p.$$
<!-- end theorem-1 -->
<!-- proposition-1: body_md -->
\label{sapsosdsod99}
For $p \geqslant 2$ and a closed subspace $\mathcal{M} \subseteq H^p$, the following are equivalent. 
\begin{enumerate}
\item $C \mathcal{M} \subseteq \mathcal{M}$; 
\item $S_t \mathcal{M} \subseteq \mathcal{M}$ for every $t \geqslant 0$. 
\end{enumerate}
<!-- end proposition-1 -->
<!-- corollary-1: body_md -->
For $0 <  p < \infty$ and $\lambda \in \mathbb{D}$, the function $k_{\lambda}$ is a cyclic vector for the Ces\`{a}ro operator on $H^p$.
<!-- end corollary-1 -->
